name: Remesh and Bake Decals
explanation_long: Remeshes to a lower face count, flattens scene graph and merges materials, creates UVs and bakes decals (garment details, logos) and material properties. Improves performance for real-time, games, XR.

exposed_options.name: Texture Baking Resolution
exposed_options.description: Resolution for baking textures. Default is 4096x4096 pixels. Values are always rounded up to the next higher powers-of-two resolution.

exposed_options.name: Face Target
exposed_options.description: The target amount of faces (triangles), default is 50,000 triangles. RapidPipeline will attempt to get as close as possible to the chosen value, though sometimes a mesh may require a slightly different final triangle count to preserve surface continuity.

exposed_options.name: Remeshing Method
exposed_options.description: Voxelization creates backsides and mesh smoothing, better for multi-layered geometry (apparel). Shrinkwrap removes backsides and preserves the original shape, better suited for hard-surface models.
